nodes.label: Case Detail UI - Timeline & Risk Summary (Spanish)
nodes.description: Screenshot of a legal case detail view in a Spanish-language UI. Shows the bottom portion of a case summary card with two bullet points describing client demands (rescision, devolucion de anticipo, indemnizacion por lucro cesante, ejecucion de fianza de cumplimiento) and a main risk note about a possible counterclaim ('cambio de requerimientos') and dissolution of NovaSoft. Below is a 'LINEA DE TIEMPO' (timeline) section with two events: 'Consulta agendada para el martes' (4/6/2026, 1:13:18 p.m.) and 'Cliente demo generado' (4/6/2026, 1:01:18 p.m.). A blue action button is partially visible at the bottom right.
nodes.purpose: Display case risk details and chronological activity timeline for a legal case involving NovaSoft
